name: serf-financorp
description: SERF — Sistema Empresarial de Gestión de Reportes Financieros de FinanCorp S.A. (NestJS + Angular)
author: Anderson Leonel Ugaz Portales

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.start: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run test:ci
